377: function averagePointOfRing(ring){
378:   if(!ring?.length)return null;
379:   let sx=0,sy=0,n=0;const step=Math.max(1,Math.floor(ring.length/120));
380:   for(let i=0;i<ring.length;i+=step){const p=ring[i];if(!Array.isArray(p)||p.length<2)continue;sx+=+p[0];sy+=+p[1];n++;}
381:   return n?[sx/n,sy/n]:null;
382: }
383: function pointInRing(pt,ring){
384:   if(!pt||!ring?.length)return false;const [x,y]=pt;let inside=false;
385:   for(let i=0,j=ring.length-1;i<ring.length;j=i++){
386:     const xi=+ring[i][0],yi=+ring[i][1],xj=+ring[j][0],yj=+ring[j][1];
387:     const hit=((yi>y)!==(yj>y))&&(x < (xj-xi)*(y-yi)/((yj-yi)||1e-14)+xi);
388:     if(hit)inside=!inside;
389:   }
390:   return inside;
391: }
392: function pointInGeoFeature(pt,feature){
393:   const g=feature?.geometry;if(!g)return false;
394:   const polys=g.type==='Polygon'?[g.coordinates]:(g.type==='MultiPolygon'?g.coordinates:[]);
395:   return polys.some(poly=>{
396:     if(!poly?.length||!pointInRing(pt,poly[0]))return false;
397:     // hole 안쪽이면 제외
398:     for(let i=1;i<poly.length;i++)if(pointInRing(pt,poly[i]))return false;
399:     return true;
400:   });
401: }

298: function outerRingsOfFeature(feature){
299:   const g=feature?.geometry;if(!g)return [];
300:   if(g.type==='Polygon')return g.coordinates?.length?[g.coordinates[0]]:[];
301:   if(g.type==='MultiPolygon')return (g.coordinates||[]).map(p=>p?.[0]).filter(Boolean);
302:   return [];
303: }
304: function averagePointOfRing(ring){
305:   if(!ring?.length)return null;
306:   let sx=0,sy=0,n=0;const step=Math.max(1,Math.floor(ring.length/120));
307:   for(let i=0;i<ring.length;i+=step){const p=ring[i];if(!Array.isArray(p)||p.length<2)continue;sx+=+p[0];sy+=+p[1];n++;}
308:   return n?[sx/n,sy/n]:null;
309: }
310: function pointInRing(pt,ring){
311:   if(!pt||!ring?.length)return false;const [x,y]=pt;let inside=false;
312:   for(let i=0,j=ring.length-1;i<ring.length;j=i++){
313:     const xi=+ring[i][0],yi=+ring[i][1],xj=+ring[j][0],yj=+ring[j][1];
314:     const hit=((yi>y)!==(yj>y))&&(x < (xj-xi)*(y-yi)/((yj-yi)||1e-14)+xi);
315:     if(hit)inside=!inside;
316:   }
317:   return inside;
318: }
319: function pointInGeoFeature(pt,feature){
320:   const g=feature?.geometry;if(!g)return false;
321:   const polys=g.type==='Polygon'?[g.coordinates]:(g.type==='MultiPolygon'?g.coordinates:[]);
322:   return polys.some(poly=>{
323:     if(!poly?.length||!pointInRing(pt,poly[0]))return false;
324:     // hole 안쪽이면 제외
325:     for(let i=1;i<poly.length;i++)if(pointInRing(pt,poly[i]))return false;
326:     return true;
327:   });
328: }
329: function inferRiDistrictByGeometry(feature,districtFeatures,riName){
330:   const candidateDistricts=Object.keys(OFFICIAL_RIS).filter(d=>officialRiAllowed(d,riName));
331:   if(!candidateDistricts.length)return '';
332:   const samples=outerRingsOfFeature(feature).map(averagePointOfRing).filter(Boolean);
333:   for(const district of candidateDistricts){
334:     const df=districtFeatures.get(district);if(!df)continue;
335:     if(samples.some(pt=>pointInGeoFeature(pt,df)))return district;
336:   }
337:   return '';
338: }

441: function normalizedRiTextCandidates(riName,riCode=''){
442:   // 오창의 두 화산리는 한글 이름만 같고 서로 다른 법정리이므로
443:   // 일반 '화산리' 문자열로 매칭하지 않고 별칭+법정리 코드로 구분한다.
444:   if(riName==='화산리' && (riCode==='4311425322'||riCode==='4311425350')){
445:     return riCode==='4311425322'
446:       ? [routeNorm('빛화산리'),routeNorm('빛화산')]
447:       : [routeNorm('꽃화산리'),routeNorm('꽃화산')];
448:   }
449:   const out=[routeNorm(riName)];
450:   const base=String(riName||'').replace(/리$/,'');
451:   if(base){
452:     for(let n=1;n<=9;n++) out.push(routeNorm(`${base}${n}리`));
453:     for(let n=1;n<=9;n++) out.push(routeNorm(`${base}${n}구`));
454:   }
455:   return [...new Set(out.filter(Boolean))];
456: }

298: function outerRingsOfFeature(feature){
299:   const g=feature?.geometry;if(!g)return [];
300:   if(g.type==='Polygon')return g.coordinates?.length?[g.coordinates[0]]:[];
301:   if(g.type==='MultiPolygon')return (g.coordinates||[]).map(p=>p?.[0]).filter(Boolean);
302:   return [];
303: }
304: function averagePointOfRing(ring){
305:   if(!ring?.length)return null;
306:   let sx=0,sy=0,n=0;const step=Math.max(1,Math.floor(ring.length/120));
307:   for(let i=0;i<ring.length;i+=step){const p=ring[i];if(!Array.isArray(p)||p.length<2)continue;sx+=+p[0];sy+=+p[1];n++;}
308:   return n?[sx/n,sy/n]:null;
309: }
310: function pointInRing(pt,ring){
311:   if(!pt||!ring?.length)return false;const [x,y]=pt;let inside=false;
312:   for(let i=0,j=ring.length-1;i<ring.length;j=i++){
313:     const xi=+ring[i][0],yi=+ring[i][1],xj=+ring[j][0],yj=+ring[j][1];
314:     const hit=((yi>y)!==(yj>y))&&(x < (xj-xi)*(y-yi)/((yj-yi)||1e-14)+xi);
315:     if(hit)inside=!inside;
316:   }
317:   return inside;
318: }
319: function pointInGeoFeature(pt,feature){
320:   const g=feature?.geometry;if(!g)return false;
321:   const polys=g.type==='Polygon'?[g.coordinates]:(g.type==='MultiPolygon'?g.coordinates:[]);
322:   return polys.some(poly=>{
323:     if(!poly?.length||!pointInRing(pt,poly[0]))return false;
324:     // hole 안쪽이면 제외
325:     for(let i=1;i<poly.length;i++)if(pointInRing(pt,poly[i]))return false;
326:     return true;
327:   });
328: }
329: function inferRiDistrictByGeometry(feature,districtFeatures,riName){
330:   const candidateDistricts=Object.keys(OFFICIAL_RIS).filter(d=>officialRiAllowed(d,riName));
331:   if(!candidateDistricts.length)return '';
332:   const samples=outerRingsOfFeature(feature).map(averagePointOfRing).filter(Boolean);
333:   for(const district of candidateDistricts){
334:     const df=districtFeatures.get(district);if(!df)continue;
335:     if(samples.some(pt=>pointInGeoFeature(pt,df)))return district;
336:   }
337:   return '';
338: }

297: function officialRiAllowed(district,riName){return !!OFFICIAL_RIS[district]?.has(riName)}
298: function outerRingsOfFeature(feature){
299:   const g=feature?.geometry;if(!g)return [];
300:   if(g.type==='Polygon')return g.coordinates?.length?[g.coordinates[0]]:[];
301:   if(g.type==='MultiPolygon')return (g.coordinates||[]).map(p=>p?.[0]).filter(Boolean);
302:   return [];
303: }
304: function averagePointOfRing(ring){
305:   if(!ring?.length)return null;
306:   let sx=0,sy=0,n=0;const step=Math.max(1,Math.floor(ring.length/120));
307:   for(let i=0;i<ring.length;i+=step){const p=ring[i];if(!Array.isArray(p)||p.length<2)continue;sx+=+p[0];sy+=+p[1];n++;}
308:   return n?[sx/n,sy/n]:null;
309: }
310: function pointInRing(pt,ring){
311:   if(!pt||!ring?.length)return false;const [x,y]=pt;let inside=false;
312:   for(let i=0,j=ring.length-1;i<ring.length;j=i++){
313:     const xi=+ring[i][0],yi=+ring[i][1],xj=+ring[j][0],yj=+ring[j][1];
314:     const hit=((yi>y)!==(yj>y))&&(x < (xj-xi)*(y-yi)/((yj-yi)||1e-14)+xi);
315:     if(hit)inside=!inside;
316:   }
317:   return inside;
318: }
319: function pointInGeoFeature(pt,feature){
320:   const g=feature?.geometry;if(!g)return false;
321:   const polys=g.type==='Polygon'?[g.coordinates]:(g.type==='MultiPolygon'?g.coordinates:[]);
322:   return polys.some(poly=>{
323:     if(!poly?.length||!pointInRing(pt,poly[0]))return false;
324:     // hole 안쪽이면 제외
325:     for(let i=1;i<poly.length;i++)if(pointInRing(pt,poly[i]))return false;
326:     return true;
327:   });
328: }
329: function inferRiDistrictByGeometry(feature,districtFeatures,riName){
330:   const candidateDistricts=Object.keys(OFFICIAL_RIS).filter(d=>officialRiAllowed(d,riName));
331:   if(!candidateDistricts.length)return '';
332:   const samples=outerRingsOfFeature(feature).map(averagePointOfRing).filter(Boolean);
333:   for(const district of candidateDistricts){
334:     const df=districtFeatures.get(district);if(!df)continue;
335:     if(samples.some(pt=>pointInGeoFeature(pt,df)))return district;
336:   }
337:   return '';
338: }
